headline: U.S. restricts trade with Chinese genomics firm BGI over forced labor allegations
summary: Washington imposed trade restrictions blocking shipments from BGI, citing alleged associations with forced labor and minority group abuses.
why: Trade bans disrupt supply chains for targeted biotechnology firms and add regulatory compliance risks for international research partners.

impacts.name: BGI
impacts.why: US trade restrictions block material shipments and international commercial access for the genomics firm.

why_moved: Imposition of formal trade restrictions by the US government abruptly cuts off key export channels and disrupts business operations for the targeted entity.
